issues.title: Malawi, Mozambique move to tackle security threats
issues.title_en: Malawi, Mozambique move to tackle security threats
issues.summary: Malawi and Mozambique have resolved to enhance stronger cross-border security cooperation to address illicit firearms, terrorism, human trafficking and organised crime which have emerged as common security threats to the two countries.
